    b=W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(float)
    for h in range(6):

        q=W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(float)

        v=W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(float)

        A[l,h]=P@(q*g).T@(k*g)@P/8
        B[l,h]=P@o@(v*g)@P
        bias[l,h]=((q@b)@(k*g)@P)/8

print("Key-composition alignment: tr(A_lh B_mj)/(||A_lh||F ||B_mj||F)")
for l in range(1,4):
    for m in range(l):
        tab=np.array([[np.trace(A[l,h]@B[m,j])/np.linalg.norm(A[l,h])/np.linalg.norm(B[m,j])
                       for j in range(6)] for h in range(6)])
        print("QK layer",l,"OV layer",m)
        print(tab)

for l in range(1,4):
    for h in range(6):
        candidates=[]
        for m in range(l):
            for j in range(6):
                C=A[l,h]@B[m,j]
                score=np.trace(C)/svdvals(C).sum()
                candidates.append((score,m,j,C))
        candidates.sort(key=lambda t:-t[0])

V=[(W["W_v.0"][64*h:64*h+64].astype(float)*g)@P for h in range(6)]
A=[q.T@k/8 for q,k in zip(Q,K)]

    q=Q[3]@R
    k=K[3]@R
    u,s,v=svd(np.concatenate([q,k]),full_matrices=False)
    print("\nRemoved value-input rank",r,"remaining QK3 spectrum",s[:40])
    T=v[:32].T/s[:32]
    Z=T.T@A[3]@T
    Z0=T.T@A[0]@T
    e,E=eig(Z)
    ix=np.argsort(np.angle(e))
    e=e[ix]; E=E[:,ix]
    transformed=np.linalg.pinv(E)@Z0@E
    diag=np.diag(transformed)

    for j in np.where(np.imag(e)>1e-5)[0]:

    print("H0 diagonal fraction",np.linalg.norm(np.diag(diag))**2/np.linalg.norm(transformed)**2)
    print("H0 whitened commutator ratio",np.linalg.norm(Z@Z0-Z0@Z)/(np.linalg.norm(Z)*np.linalg.norm(Z0)))
    z=np.eye(len(Z))
    for power in range(1,7):
        z=z@Z
        print("power",power,"cos with H0",np.sum(z*Z0)/np.linalg.norm(z)/np.linalg.norm(Z0))

import numpy as np

from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from scipy.sparse.csgraph import laplacian
np.set_printoptions(precision=3,suppress=True,linewidth=200)

P=np.eye(d)-np.ones((d,d))/d
F=(W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"])@P
sl=slice(192,256)
B=P@W["W_o.0"][:,sl].astype(float)@(W["W_v.0"][sl].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.0"])@P
G=F@B

    X=X/np.linalg.norm(X,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    Y=Y/np.linalg.norm(Y,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    km=KMeans(n_clusters=k,n_init=15,random_state=0).fit(X)
